definitions.explanation: A short pin with a flat, broad head used to fasten papers or posters to a board or wall.

examples.japanese: {画鋲|がびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ポスター→ポスター：09598_posutaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}った→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: I pinned up the poster with thumbtacks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちていた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{画鋲|がびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んで→踏む：01197_fumu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally stepped on a thumbtack that had fallen on the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{画鋲|がびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{留|と}めて→留める：10053_tomeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pin the notices to the bulletin board with thumbtacks.

notes:
Combines {画|が} (picture/drawing) and {鋲|びょう} (tack/rivet). Originally used to pin drawings and documents, the name persists even though thumbtacks are now used for many purposes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画鋲|がびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}める→留める：10053_tomeru⟧: fasten with a thumbtack
- {画鋲|がびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: pin up with thumbtacks
- {画鋲|がびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: stick in a thumbtack
- {画鋲|がびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: pull out a thumbtack
- {画鋲|がびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: step on a thumbtack

USAGE:
A common everyday word learned early in school life. Japanese classrooms typically use {画鋲|がびょう} to attach items to cork bulletin boards (⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧). The word is universally understood across Japan, though some regions may use the older reading ⟦{押|お}し→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧: pin — a more general loanword; can refer to various types of pins
- ⟦{押|お}し→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧: pushpin — dialectal variant (mainly Kansai region) for the same item
